citation.authors: Ibero-Baraibar I, Suárez M, Arola-Arnal A, Zulet MA, Martínez JA
citation.title: Cocoa extract intake for 4 weeks reduces postprandial systolic blood pressure response of obese subjects, even after following an energy-restricted diet

population.description: The control group of the substudy: 12 overweight/obese middle-aged volunteers (6 men, 6 women), age and BMI as printed for this group in Table 1 (age 57 (4.9) y, BMI 30.2 (2.2) kg/m2). Enrolment: age 50 to 80 y, BMI 27.0 to 35.5 kg/m2, stable weight; diabetes, gastrointestinal, hepatic, inflammatory disease, cancer, smoking and blood pressure, lipid or weight-loss treatment excluded. No glucose test is reported, so unselected. The cocoa group is not entered.

protocols.name: fasted_morning
protocols.description: The fasted morning of day 1 for the Table 1 baseline values, after the stated 10-h overnight fast, nothing eaten; the table does not say on which occasion it was drawn, so a 30-min run-in with the value read at minutes 29-30 is assumed. The 3 days of low-polyphenol diet before are not entered.

protocols.name: control_day1
protocols.description: Postprandial 1 (day 1 of the 4-week intervention), control group: after a 10-h overnight fast (stated), a test meal without cocoa extract at minute 0 (courgette cream 300 g and chocolate custard 150 g; whole meal 365 kcal: carbohydrate 34.2 g, lipid 20.9 g, protein 8.9 g, fibre 4.9 g as printed for the meal, which the paper gives for the cocoa-containing meal; the 1.4 g extract is the only stated difference). Samples and blood pressure at 0, 60, 120, 180 min. The 3 days of low-polyphenol diet before the study (fruit and vegetables restricted, no cocoa, coffee, tea, juice, alcohol) change neither energy nor macronutrients as printed and are not entered; the clock time is not printed.

findings.description: Fasting plasma glucose at baseline (Table 1), control group; the table does not say on which occasion it was drawn, taken as the fasted morning
Fasting insulin at baseline (Table 1), control group; occasion as for glucose

Diastolic blood pressure at baseline (Table 1), control group; occasion as for glucose (seated)

Area under the systolic pressure curve 0-180 min after the test meal, Postprandial 1, control; trapezoid on the 4 readings, unadjusted mean (SD)
Area under the diastolic pressure curve 0-180 min after the test meal, Postprandial 1, control; trapezoid on the 4 readings, unadjusted mean (SD)

left_out.what: the cocoa group (n=11): every value, which follows a test meal with 1.4 g cocoa extract (415 mg flavanols); Tables 1, 2, 3 and Figure 2
Postprandial 2 (day 28) values of the control group, Table 2: after 4 weeks of a 15% energy-restricted diet whose meals are not printed in grams, and 3 days of prescribed test meals before
insulin area under the curve, Postprandial 1 control (Table 2), printed in µU·h/dL; the area divided by 3 h is 0.25 µU/mL against a fasting 7.6 µU/mL, so the unit is a misprint
total cholesterol and HDL cholesterol at baseline and their areas (Tables 1 and 2)
cocoa-derived metabolites in plasma (Table 3), measured in the cocoa group on day 1 and not in the control group
systolic pressure curve at 0, 60, 120, 180 min (Figure 2) and the group difference at 120 min (p = 0.018); means in the figure only
